# Farbod Younesi

> Official English and Persian portfolio of Farbod Younesi (فربد یونسی), an electrical engineer and researcher working on robotics and control systems, cyber-physical systems security, autonomous vehicles, and computer vision.

## English

- [Profile](https://farbodynsi.github.io/): Biography, education, technical skills, and RoboCup awards.
- [Research and publications](https://farbodynsi.github.io/research.html): Research interests, publication status, and research experience.
- [Robotics projects](https://farbodynsi.github.io/projects.html): A scale-model self-driving car, a retail inventory-tracking robot, and an ESP32 smart-home project.
- [Industry collaboration](https://farbodynsi.github.io/collaboration.html): Pilot ideas, hardware in development, and partnership and funding inquiries.
- [Courses and teaching](https://farbodynsi.github.io/courses.html): Robot Control Bootcamp and university teaching experience.
- [Contact](https://farbodynsi.github.io/contact.html): Professional contact details and profiles.

## فارسی

- [نمایه و سوابق](https://farbodynsi.github.io/fa/): معرفی، تحصیلات، مهارت‌ها و جوایز.
- [پژوهش و مقالات](https://farbodynsi.github.io/fa/research.html): علایق، مقالات و سوابق پژوهشی.
- [پروژه‌های رباتیک](https://farbodynsi.github.io/fa/projects.html): خودروی خودران، ربات پایش موجودی و خانهٔ هوشمند.
- [همکاری صنعتی](https://farbodynsi.github.io/fa/collaboration.html): طرح‌های آزمایشی، پروژه‌های در حال توسعه و فرصت‌های همکاری و تأمین مالی.
- [دوره‌ها و تدریس](https://farbodynsi.github.io/fa/courses.html): دورهٔ کنترل ربات و سوابق تدریس.
- [تماس](https://farbodynsi.github.io/fa/contact.html): راه‌های تماس و نمایه‌های حرفه‌ای.

## Primary references

- [IEEE CCTA 2026 proceedings paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/CCTA62090.2026.11684307): Trojan Attacks on Neural Network Controllers for Robotic Systems, by Farbod Younesi, Walter Lucia, and Amr Youssef.
- [arXiv preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05121): Abstract and open preprint for the CCTA paper.
- [PreCySe Group at Concordia University](https://users.encs.concordia.ca/~wlucia/Group.html): The Predictive Cyber-Physical System Security Group’s university page.
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=7HzUuhoAAAAJ&hl=en): Farbod Younesi’s publication profile.
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/farbodYNSI): Public software projects and repositories.
